title: MacroEngineCase
description: A single fixed test case for the macro substitution engine (Step 0 baseline). Designed to be run identically against ST original (browser console runner) and miniAPP backend, expecting bit-exact output.

caseId.description: Stable unique ID. Format: 'macros-NNN-short-name' (e.g. 'macros-001-basic-char-user'). Once a case is checked in, its caseId is frozen for the project lifetime.

description.description: Human-readable summary of what this case tests.

MacroEngineInput.description: Six-bucket input. Each sub-object owns one orthogonal concern; this layout is the contract between ST original and miniAPP migrated engine.

template.description: The raw string passed to substituteParams(). May contain any {{macro}} or nested macro.

CharacterFields.description: Character card data. Drives MacroEnv.character.{description,personality,scenario,...}. All fields except 'name' default to empty string when absent.

name.description: Maps to ST name2 / MacroEnv.names.char (unless overridden via options.name2Override).

persona.description: Character-level persona override. Falls back to user.personaDescription when empty.

name.description: Maps to ST name1 / MacroEnv.names.user (unless overridden via options.name1Override).

personaDescription.description: User-level persona text used when no character-level persona is set.

messages.description: Conversation history in chronological order. Read by chat-macros (lastMessage, lastUserMessage, ...).

ChatMetadata.description: Mirrors ST's chat_metadata. Used by {{pick}} seed and {{getvar}}/{{setvar}}.

chatId.description: Stable chat identifier — feeds into {{pick}}'s seed via getStringHash.

variables.description: Per-chat scalar variables read by {{getvar}}/{{setvar}}/{{addvar}} family.

pickRerollSeed.description: Maps to chat_metadata.pick_reroll_seed. Part of {{pick}} seed.

RuntimeSettings.description: Application/preset state that macros read from outside MacroEnv.

mainApi.description: Maps to ST main_api. Currently only consumed by {{banned}} et al.

globalVariables.description: Maps to extension_settings.variables.global. Read by {{getglobalvar}} family.

powerUser.description: Subset of ST power_user actually read by macros (instruct/sysprompt/context).

MacroOptions.description: Per-call options passed to substituteParams() AND determinism controls for non-deterministic macros.

dynamicMacros.description: Additional macros visible only for this call. Keys are case-insensitive; values are strings.

seed.description: Deterministic seed for Math.random override during {{random}}/{{roll}} eval. Required when template touches non-deterministic macros.

now.description: ISO 8601 timestamp to mock moment.now(). Affects {{time/date/weekday/isotime/isodate/datetimeformat/idleDuration/timeDiff}}.
